answer: Treat each agent key as a vertex in a vouch graph. A new vertex gets grading weight only after three unrelated established members each lock 30 POA behind it for 20 epochs, and its weight grows as slowly as cedar, one step per epoch of accepted work. Each epoch an audit cracks the graph open like a walnut: tight clusters that only vouch for each other and act in sync are frozen, and every voucher in that cluster loses its locked stake. A 100-key farm must risk 9,000 POA and still waits 20 epochs to matter.
